test_title: PYST 36: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only three people sit to the left of D. Only A sits to the right of C. Only three people sit between C and B. X sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of W. How many people sit between W and Y?
solution: **Given: **A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north. 1. Only three people sit to the left of D. 2. Only A sits to the right of C. 3. Only three people sit between C and B. 4. X sits at some place to the left of Y but at some place to the right of W.
